basic_info.description: Outer Richmond Spanish-Mediterranean single-family home just four blocks from Ocean Beach and Sunset Dunes. This beautifully updated 2 bed, 1 bath residence features a sun-filled living room with a wood-burning fireplace, a formal dining room, and an updated kitchen and bath that blend modern finishes with classic character. Both bedrooms enjoy peaceful ocean views and generous closets.  Situated on a 3,000 sq ft lot, the expansive backyard offers ocean views, a large patio, shaded deck, and room to garden. The massive garage provides 2-car parking, abundant storage, and washer/dryer hookups. The home offers tons of expansion potential! With a new roof, updated electrical and recent remodele this home is move-in ready! Located on a prime Outer Richmond block with easy access to Golden Gate Park, Lands End, and vibrant local favorites like Andytown Coffee, Devil's Teeth Bakery, and the Balboa Theater. Convenient transit access via the 31 Balboa line. 831 45th Avenue is a rare opportunity to own a move-in ready home in one of San Francisco's most beloved and evolving neighborhoods - with room to dream, grow, and thrive.
